meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 把旧版 NanoClaw 和 Claude 的记忆文件迁移到统一 memory 树:隔离符号链接,合并常驻指令,整理核心事实与概念文件,最后生成核对和回滚报告。
howto.when: 在更新提示共享记忆不兼容,或发现 .seed.md、旧版 CLAUDE.md 等遗留文件时触发;也可说“migrate memory”等关键词。

say.text: 把 .seed.md 和 CLAUDE.md 迁移到共享记忆树。
say.note: 会先列出受影响分组并请求批准。

say.text: 检查旧版 Claude 自动记忆并整理进 memory 目录。
say.note: 迁移期间暂停任务,完成后恢复。

say.text: 哪些链接被隔离了?给我看迁移报告。
say.note: 会展示来源到目标的完整记录。

howto.what_en: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude memory files into the unified memory tree: quarantine symlinks, merge standing instructions, organize core facts and concept files, then produce a reviewable, reversible report.
howto.when_en: Runs when an update reports a shared-memory breaking change, or when legacy files like .seed.md or legacy CLAUDE.md remain; also on phrases like 'migrate memory'.

say_en.text: Migrate .seed.md and CLAUDE.md into the shared memory tree.
say_en.note: It lists affected groups and asks approval first.

say_en.text: Check legacy Claude auto-memory and organize it into the memory folder.
say_en.note: Tasks are paused during migration and resumed after.

say_en.text: Which links were quarantined? Show me the migration report.
